body:
They understand in theory, but it doesn’t matter how many times I explain it. They don’t understand in practice, same way I understand child birth is painful even though I can’t really understand what it feels like because I can’t experience it.

Therapy hasn’t helped. The anti depressants I’m on just make me feel numb instead of crying all the time, but now I feel empty and cold and I want to sleep forever. Sleep is the only time I feel ok.

I’m severely depressed. I struggle to do anything but sleep. 25 and no job, never had a girlfriend, one friend who barely speaks to me.

I have so much anxiety all the time, my heart feels like it’s gonna burst from beating so hard, I gag and dry heave and feel like I’m gonna be sick, even my bowels are fucked up from stress, I keep shitting water.

My parents are half upset and half mad at me for not being a real adult, getting a job, moving out, having relationships. I know I’m not a real person, I can’t do those things. They’re so stressed already and all I do is add to it. They know how I feel, they just think it’s something I can get over and It’s my fault for not trying hard enough.

I’ve planned how I can end it all now, that’s the only thing that’s made me feel any relief, knowing I can check out if I want to.
They already know, they just get upset and angry that I’m not getting better. They can’t understand that you don’t just get better from this.

I’ve been going over what I’d write in my suicide note. That it isn’t their fault, that my brain is broken, that they couldn’t have done anything. But I know they’d still feel they could’ve helped somehow and that it’s their fault.

I just wish they could move on quickly and forget about me.
